lines.japanese: 「ぱね田君──」
lines.english: “Pane... da?”

lines.japanese: 「──じゃないのかな？」
lines.english: “Or are you not?”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、さっきから見てたんだけど、今日なんか違くない？　キミ、ぱね田君じゃないとか？　羽田君？　え、誰？」
lines.english: “I’ve been watching you for a while. Aren’t you acting different today? Are you not Paneda? Are you Haneda? Who are you?”

lines.japanese: どの俺が返事をしますか？
lines.english: Which of us will answer?

lines.japanese: ありがとう。僕を選んでくれた君に。
lines.english: Thank you—to you, who chose me.

lines.japanese: そして、僕を待ってくれていた貴女に。
lines.english: And to you, who waited for me.

lines.japanese: 「また逢えたね、渡来さん」
lines.english: “We meet again, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと見てたよ。いろいろ、ありがとう」
lines.english: “I was always watching. Thank you for everything.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だから！　そういうのやめてって言ったじゃん！」
lines.english: “I-I told you to stop doing that!”

lines.japanese: 「え？　なにが？」
lines.english: “What? Doing what?”

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田のくせに、は、羽田君みたいな声を出すなっ」
lines.english: “You’re Paneda! D-don’t use Haneda’s voice!”

lines.japanese: 狼少年の悲劇。
lines.english: The tragedy of the boy who cried wolf.

lines.japanese: これまで幾度となく交わされた僕を忘れてもらうための戯れは、決して無駄ではなかったということだ。皮肉なことに。
lines.english: All those little games we had played so she would forget me had not been in vain. How ironic.

lines.japanese: 「そうか……そうだよね……」
lines.english: “I see... Of course...”

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: May peace prevail on Earth.

lines.japanese: 「うん、なんでもないんだ、ごめんね渡来さん」
lines.english: “It’s nothing. Sorry, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「うっ……ちくしょうぱね山ぱね男め、だんだん羽田君の真似が上手くなってきやがった」
lines.english: “Ugh... Damn you, Paneman Paneyama. You’re getting better and better at impersonating Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha.”

lines.japanese: 眉間に皺を刻んで睨むその様がなんだかとても彼女らしくて、僕は思わず笑ってしまった。
lines.english: The way she glared at me with a crease between her eyebrows felt so perfectly like her that I could not help laughing.

lines.japanese: 「なんか……楽しいな……」
lines.english: “This is... nice...”

lines.japanese: それは「欠けている」僕にも許された、数少ない感情表現だから。
lines.english: It was one of the few forms of emotion permitted to a person as “incomplete” as I was.

lines.japanese: だから僕はいつだって笑ってきた。楽しいときも困ったときも許せないときも。
lines.english: That was why I had always smiled—when I was happy, when I was troubled, even when I was furious.

lines.japanese: 悲しいときも。
lines.english: Even when I was sad.

lines.japanese: 「あの……ねえ、一応聞くけど……」
lines.english: “Um... Look, I have to ask...”

lines.japanese: 「ひょっとして、本当に羽田君……だったりしない？」
lines.english: “Is there any chance you really are Haneda?”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 彼女には分かるんだ。僕を分かってくれるんだ。
lines.english: She knew. She understood me.

lines.japanese: こんなに嬉しいことはない。
lines.english: Nothing could have made me happier.

lines.japanese: けれど。
lines.english: And yet...

lines.japanese: 「まさか。そんなことないよ」
lines.english: “Of course not. That’s impossible.”

lines.japanese: いまの僕は所詮かりそめの存在であって、いまさら羽田タカシという自我を主張することに意味はない。
lines.english: I was only a fleeting existence now. There was no point asserting an ego called Takashi Haneda after all this time.

lines.japanese: 刹那に弾けるうたかたなら、密やかに現れ、速やかに去ってゆこう。
lines.english: If I was a bubble destined to burst in an instant, I would appear in secret and depart just as swiftly.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: May peace prevail on Earth.

lines.japanese: 「それより渡来さん。おれ、妹のために署名を集めてるんだ。良かったらでいいんだけど、協力してくれないかな」
lines.english: “More importantly, Watarai, I’m collecting signatures for my sister. Only if you want to, but would you help?”

lines.japanese: 「え……ああ、そんなのは減るもんじゃなし、頼まれれば十個でも二十個でも書くけど……」
lines.english: “Huh...? Sure. A signature doesn’t cost me anything. If you ask, I’ll write ten or twenty.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。だからおれは渡来さんが好きだったんだ。なんちゃって」
lines.english: “Thank you. That’s why I loved you, Watarai. Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: 消えゆくさだめは、いたずらに僕を強気にさせた。
lines.english: Knowing I would soon disappear made me uncharacteristically bold.

lines.japanese: 「や、やっぱり羽田君じゃない……羽田君はそんな冗談言わない」
lines.english: “Y-you really aren’t Haneda... He would never joke like that.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。これはひどい冗談だ」
lines.english: “You’re right. It was a terrible joke.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ、冗談には冗談で返すけど」
lines.english: “Oh. Then I’ll answer your joke with one of my own.”

lines.japanese: 「そう、だからコレ、１００パー冗談だけど」
lines.english: “This is one hundred percent a joke, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「私も、羽田君好きだよ。なんちゃって」
lines.english: “I love you too, Haneda. Just kidding.”
“Ha-ha...”

lines.japanese: 熱く潤んでしまった瞳を見られたくなくて、僕は俯いた。
lines.english: I lowered my head, unwilling to let her see the heat and tears gathering in my eyes.

lines.japanese: ありがとう。いま、ひとたびだけ、僕と彼女をふたたび巡りあわせてくれた君へ。
lines.english: Thank you—to you, who allowed the two of us to meet again for this one moment.

lines.japanese: さようなら。埃だらけで不鮮明だった僕の景色を、まばゆく色付けてくれた貴女へ。
lines.english: Goodbye—to you, who bathed my dusty, indistinct world in dazzling color.

lines.japanese: 世界が金色でありますように。
lines.english: May the world be golden.

lines.japanese: へ？　俺っすか？
lines.english: Huh? Me?

lines.japanese: いや、そりゃ明日香さんとは一応面識ありますけど……でも、あんまり相性よくないと思うんすよねえ。
lines.english: I mean, I’ve met Asuka before, sure... But I don’t think we get along all that well.

lines.japanese: ま、渉外担当っすから、行けって言われたら行きますけど……。
lines.english: Well, I’m in charge of external relations. If you tell me to go, I’ll go...

lines.japanese: 「ハイどーも。千歳ぬるぬる鷲介っすコンバンワ」
lines.english: “Hey there. Slippery Shuusuke Chitose at your service. Good evening.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、鷲のひと」
lines.english: “Oh, the eagle guy.”

lines.japanese: 「お久しぶりっす、友達思いの渡来明日香さん。相変わらずそういうトコ目鼻が利くみたいで。よく分かりましたねえ、羽田君がいつもと違うって」
lines.english: “Long time no see, Asuka Watarai, loyal friend to all. Your nose for this stuff is sharp as ever. I’m impressed you noticed that Haneda was acting different.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君じゃなくて、ぱね田君がね」
lines.english: “Not Haneda. Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「どう違いました？」
lines.english: “What was different about him?”

lines.japanese: 「違うっていうか、フツーに変だったし。授業中めまぐるしく、ニヤニヤしたりムスッとしたり、自分の髪ひっつかんで一人喧嘩始めたり」
lines.english: “It’s less that he was different and more that he was acting completely bizarre. All through class, he kept switching between grinning and sulking, grabbing his own hair, and fighting with himself.”

lines.japanese: 「ただの挙動不審者！」
lines.english: “That’s just straight-up suspicious behavior!”

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田内でなにを争ってたんですか」
lines.english: “So what were all the people inside Paneda arguing about?”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　ああ、そうだった」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, right.”

lines.japanese: どうしたらいかに効率良く署名を集められるか、議論してたんだった。
lines.english: We had been debating how to collect signatures as efficiently as possible.

lines.japanese: 「いや、実は俺たち、ちょっと子供の夢を守るボランティア活動みたいの始めましてね。良かったらコレに署名してもらえません？」
lines.english: “Well, the truth is, we’ve started a little volunteer campaign to protect children’s dreams. Would you mind signing this?”

lines.japanese: 「やだ。羽田君に替わってくれたら書く」
lines.english: “No. I’ll sign if you switch to Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「またそういうことを……」
lines.english: “There you go again...”

lines.japanese: だからこのひと苦手。
lines.english: This was why I had trouble with her.

lines.japanese: 「信用してないひとがやってる署名運動なんか、協力できるわけないし」
lines.english: “I can’t support a petition being run by somebody I don’t trust.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、ごもっともだわ」
lines.english: “Well, that’s perfectly reasonable.”

lines.japanese: ほらあ、人選まちがってるじゃん死神サン！　無視してないで、早くタカシ君に替えて替えて！
lines.english: See, Mr. Reaper? You chose the wrong guy! Quit ignoring me and switch me to Takashi! Hurry up!

lines.japanese: あ、無理なの？　そんなすぐには？　へーへー、そうですかー。
lines.english: Oh, you can’t? Not that quickly? Fine, fine. I see how it is.

lines.japanese: 「あーあ、明日香さんは本当にタカシ君が好きだなあ」
lines.english: “Wow, Asuka, you really do love Takashi.”

lines.japanese: 「そーでもないけど、もっと色んな話はしておきたかったよね」
lines.english: “Not particularly. But I do wish we’d had the chance to talk about more things.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。じゃあもしかして、署名に協力してくれたらタカシ君出てくるかもしんないっすよ」
lines.english: “Huh. Well, if you cooperate with the petition, maybe Takashi will come out.”

lines.japanese: 「え……そうなの？」
lines.english: “...Really?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: あれ、意外と効果てきめん……？
lines.english: Wow. That was surprisingly effective...?

lines.japanese: 「ほんとに？」
lines.english: “Do you mean it?”

lines.japanese: げっ、やばい、明日香さん目がマジだ。恋愛顔だ。考えなしでテキトー言っただけなのに、そんなに素で期待されては困ります。
lines.english: Crap. Her eyes were serious. That was the face of a girl in love. I’d made up some thoughtless nonsense, and now she was honestly getting her hopes up. This was bad.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いや、どーすかねえ。単なる俺の予想でしかないんすけど」
lines.english: “Ah, well, who knows? It’s only a guess on my part.”

lines.japanese: 「分かった……じゃあ、書く……」
lines.english: “Okay... Then I’ll sign...”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「そーすか？　あ、いや……あの、あんまり無理しなくてもいいすけど……」
lines.english: “You will? I mean... You don’t have to force yourself...”

lines.japanese: 「いい。書きたい。やっぱ、なんか……そんな気分」
lines.english: “It’s fine. I want to. Somehow... it feels right.”

lines.japanese: 「……へへっ」
lines.english: “...Heh-heh.”

lines.japanese: 恋するハニカミ！
lines.english: A maiden’s bashful smile!

lines.japanese: 「あーそーだーこの署名用紙ミスがあったんだー！　ちょおーっと出力しなおしてきますねー！」
lines.english: “Oh, that’s right! There was an error on the petition! I’ll just go reprint it!”

lines.japanese: 良心の呵責に耐えきれなくなった俺は、明日香さんから用紙を回収して逃げだしました。
lines.english: Unable to bear the pangs of my conscience, I snatched the page back from Asuka and fled.

lines.japanese: 「刷りなおしたら言いなよー、協力するからー」
lines.english: “Tell me when you’ve reprinted it! I’ll help!”

lines.japanese: 「は、はいィ！　機会があれば！」
lines.english: “Y-yes! If the opportunity arises!”

lines.japanese: 俺かよ。めんどくせえな。こういうのは外交官の担当だろ。
lines.english: You picked me? What a pain in the ass. This is the diplomat’s job.

lines.japanese: 自分で言うのもなんだけど、俺に対人関係任せたらロクなことンなんねーぞ。知らねーかんな。
lines.english: I know myself well enough to say it: putting me in charge of human relations never ends well. Don’t say I didn’t warn you.

lines.japanese: とりあえず脚を机に載せてから、威圧。
lines.english: First, I put my feet up on the desk. Then I glared her down.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　なんだよ女、俺が誰だろうと関係ねーだろうがブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “The hell do you want, woman? Who I am ain’t any of your business. I’ll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……なんか一度会ったことある恐いひとだ」
lines.english: “Oh... You’re that scary guy I met once.”

lines.japanese: あん？　こいつ、タカシの女だろ。俺と遭遇したことなんかあったか？　覚えねえぞ。
lines.english: Huh? This is Takashi’s woman, right? Have I run into her before? I don’t remember.

lines.japanese: 「つーか、誰が恐いひとだテメ。こういうのは硬派っつンだよ。滲みでる男臭さっつーか？　危険な香りっつーか？　まあアレだ、ハードボイルドだ」
lines.english: “Who the fuck are you callin’ scary? This is called being a man’s man. Raw masculinity, you know? The scent of danger? Whatever. I’m hard-boiled.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、意外と恐くない……てか、なんだ、単なる偉そう芸人か」
lines.english: “Huh. You’re less scary than I thought... Oh, I get it. You’re just a comedian doing a big-shot act.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ、俺芸人じゃねえんだよ。俺芸人じゃねえんだよ。つか、誰おまえ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I ain’t a comedian. I ain’t a comedian. Anyway, who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「いるよね、舐められる前に舐めろみたいな。そういうの、第一印象で損するんじゃない？　逆に陰で失笑されてると思う」
lines.english: “You’re one of those people who thinks, ‘Look down on them before they can look down on you,’ aren’t you? I bet that first impression costs you. People are probably snickering behind your back.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、諭してンじゃねえよ。そんなしょっぱい御訓告じゃ俺のハートは震えねーんだよ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Quit lecturing me. That lame-ass sermon ain’t gonna stir my heart.”

lines.japanese: 「いいからコレ。あの、名前？　名前書いてくんない。いま署名集めてんの俺ら」
lines.english: “Whatever. Here. Write your name on this, would ya? We’re collecting signatures.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　何いきなり。やだよ」
lines.english: “What? Where did that come from? No.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、シュパーッと書きゃいいんだよシュパーッと。名前ぐらい何いちいちケチってんだよ。減るもんじゃねーんだから十個や二十個シュパーッと書けよ」
lines.english: “Quit whining and write it down. Zip-zip! Why be stingy with your own name? It ain’t gonna wear out. Write it ten or twenty times. Zip-zip!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ羽田君に替わってくれたらシュパーッと書く」
lines.english: “Then switch to Haneda and I’ll write it down. Zip-zip.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに。おまえタカシのこと好きなの」
lines.english: “Huh? What, you got a thing for Takashi?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに？　そういうわけじゃないよね」
lines.english: “Not really. It isn’t like that.”

lines.japanese: 「だったら俺でいいじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Then I oughta be fine.”

lines.japanese: 「や、でもこれは確か。私、上から目線とかオレ様キャラ、嫌い」
lines.english: “No, but I know this much: I hate guys who talk down to people and act like they own the place.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、結構だよ。バリバリ嫌ってくれよ。こちとら、そんなに大勢の他人から好かれたいとは思っちゃねえんだよ」
lines.english: “Great. Hate my fucking guts. I don’t need a whole crowd of strangers to like me.”

lines.japanese: 「でも今日ンとこは名前書いてもらわねえと困るから、ちょっぴり下手に出てやるよ。お願いします名前書きやがってくださいてめえブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “But today I need your name, so I’ll humble myself just a little. Please write your goddamn name, you asshole, I’ll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい、だから羽田君に替わってくれたら、シュパーッと書くってば」
lines.english: “Sure, sure. Like I said, switch to Haneda and I’ll write it. Zip-zip.”

lines.japanese: 「無理。上の判断で俺が出てンだよ、そんな気軽にシュパーッと替われねーの」
lines.english: “Can’t. The folks upstairs decided I’m out here. We can’t just switch, zip-zip, whenever we feel like it.”

lines.japanese: 「それじゃあ交渉決裂だよね」
lines.english: “Then negotiations have broken down.”

lines.japanese: 女はシュパーッと去った。
lines.english: The woman zipped away.

lines.japanese: 「上等だっつの」
lines.english: “Fine by me.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの背中に目潰しピースを送った。
lines.english: I sent a two-fingered eye-jab salute after her retreating back.

lines.japanese: 「で、おまえ誰」
lines.english: “Wait, who are you?”
